# clearml_queue (Data Source)

Looks up one ClearML queue by its exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clearml_queue" "production_gpu" {
  name = "gpu-production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required
